comment: Honestly a buck more on the individual plan is still a steal, and the family plan is still the cheapest way to have Spotify for our house. I don't love the price creep every year but Connect across all our devices and podcasts plus music in one app makes it worth it to me.
Lol cool, Premium goes up again and I'm still stuck on free with ads and skip limits. Why do I have to pay for basic stuff that should just come with the app? Ridiculous at this point.

Price going up while the queue still restarts songs and the Mix thing keeps closing on me, wtf. I'll keep paying for the lossless stuff for now but if these bugs don't get fixed I'm moving to Apple Music, this update sucks.

Another increase and my country still doesn't get lossless or the AI playlists, so we pay the same price as everyone and get less. It's worth it for the household, sure, but region locked features at the same price is not a good experience and it feels arbitrary.

Student went from 5.99 to 6.99, so I'm still a student for a bit and I'll keep it. My real worry is whether the Hulu access that comes with the student plan survives this change, because losing Hulu would hurt more than the extra dollar. Anyone know if the bundle is changing?

Raising prices again while artists get pennies and AI slop floods my Discover Weekly? Pay the artists, Spotify, not your shareholders. I already left once and I'm only hanging around because of the convenience, so this is the last straw unless they actually deal with the fake artists.

Eh, I'm not thrilled about another buck, but I've been paying for over a decade and I'm not going back to Apple Music. The recommendations still suck and Made For You still crowds out everything, but my years of liked songs are here so I'll stay. Would be nicer if the money went into making the app better.

Premium going to 12.99 is annoying but whatever, people who already pay don't care. Free is still ass with the skip limits, but I'm not paying 13 bucks when YouTube Premium does the same thing for less. I guess I'll stay on free and drink the ads.

Prices keep going up while the app breaks after every update, and Amazon Music is cheaper and has playlists Spotify is missing. I already cancelled once after the bugs and support was useless. I'm moving my playlists over and I'm done paying for something that won't play the next song.

So the price goes up a buck on the February billing date. Will someone please make sure the cancel button actually stops the charge? I cancelled last month and still got billed, and support just sent me the same copy paste reply. Not happy about this.

A dollar more is fine by me, it's still way cheaper than buying the albums I listen to. I'm on Premium for the ad-free listening, offline downloads and uploading my own music, and that's worth it for me. Would be nice if the podcast ads went away but I'm not complaining about the price.

Duo going up 2 bucks is fine as long as the stuff they promised actually shows up on our account. We're still waiting on features that were supposed to roll out ages ago. Discover Weekly is part of my week so I'll stick around for now, but this is getting old.

Meh, a bit more on Duo won't make me switch. Rebuilding years of playlists somewhere else is a pain and I already paid a tool to move things once. What I actually want is folders and a way to tag songs, which still don't exist, so paying more with nothing new is annoying.

A buck more for ad-free access to basically all the music ever recorded is still the best deal I spend money on. Paying artists matters more than a dollar here. People who grumble about this should go look up what a CD costs.

Another price bump, and shuffle still plays the same 10 to 15 songs over and over? I already cancelled once and free shuffle honestly works better for my 9k playlist anyway. Not paying more for a worse shuffle. Done, back to free.

Ugh, more money for a Premium that still plays random songs instead of my playlist? Is anyone else seeing playlists go empty again? I'm not sure I'd pay more unless the playback problems get fixed. I already moved to Apple Music once when it broke.

Premium goes up another buck and I still get three unskippable Spotify ads in the middle of my podcast. Premium is supposed to be ad free, that's the whole point of paying a stupid amount. I already moved my shows to Pocket Casts and I'll delete my account if one more ad sneaks into an episode.
Doesn't really matter to me. I'm on Bluetooth and 320 is plenty, nobody can hear a real difference with lossless on earbuds anyway. I don't care what they charge for it, I'm not switching.

Lol, they raise prices while Discover Weekly is full of AI slop and the same songs in rotation. I already cancelled over this and moved to Apple Music. Pay the artists? Spotify pays them pennies. Not giving them more money for that.

Great, more money for a podcast app that just removed my New Episodes folder and plays some episodes in reverse. I still love the UI and my playlists are here so I'm not leaving yet, but it's getting harder to justify a price hike. Apple Podcasts is looking better every update.

Another price increase while the same bug from before still kills my playlists? I tried reinstalling everything and nothing worked for me. I'm paying for something that doesn't work and that feels bad. If it's still broken by spring I'm out, probably to YouTube Music.

Apple Music is already cheaper and sounds better, so Spotify going up another dollar just makes it harder to justify. I'm still here for the playlists and because switching is a pain, but I keep coming back to Apple Music for the sound. Not great.

So they want more money from me while artists get pennies per stream and the CEO is a billionaire. Raising the price on a platform that pushes stock music and AI tracks into playlists is a joke. I keep paying because the sub is how I support artists, but I'm spending more directly on Bandcamp every month.

Family plan going up two bucks, and still no lossless on it. Per person it's still the cheapest way to have Spotify for my household so I'm not going anywhere. But I got locked out over the address stuff last month and now they want more money? Come on.

Price goes up and there's still no true lossless here. Tidal already gives me proper lossless and I'm not paying more for a bitrate I can get elsewhere. I'll stay for the recommendations but this is the last straw on the price side.

Cool, another price bump and they still haven't brought back the features they quietly removed. Features keep disappearing and the app keeps getting more ads and bloat. I'll keep Premium for crossfade and Spicetify but I'm not thrilled about it.

Paying more for the family plan while the discography is still hidden is ridiculous, and the lyrics screen is still ugly too. I'll keep the family plan for now because the catalog is the catalog, but if the artist pages don't come back I'm going back to YouTube Music.

Spotify going up again? I already pay for YouTube Premium, which includes a music player, so this is really hard to justify. I stay for Jam with friends, but if the recommendations keep repeating I'm switching to YouTube Music.
